_comment: Vortex multi-wave grid (BloFin) with auto_max_waves and a geometric rescue ladder.
_note: BloFin variant. BloFin fees: maker 2bps, taker 6bps (minimum_tp tuned to 0.2%). round_min_qty_blofin enabled. auto_max_waves resolves max_waves and wave_share at boot; scale_cap=false keeps the risk ceiling at the wallet_exposure-derived value while quantities still scale with volatility.

vortex_dca._math: wallet_exposure caps total position notional (e.g. 70 = $70 on a $100 wallet).
vortex_dca._comment_grid_mode: === ORDERBOOK-ANCHORED GRID === Levels are placed at real bid/ask walls (numpy-histogram bins of orderbook qty) instead of fixed-pct spacings. Falls back to LINEAR if the book is too thin to bin nr_clusters walls in band.
vortex_dca._comment_gridspan_sizing: Gridspan-normalized sizing: quantities scale with live outer_distance relative to reference_outer_distance, clamped to [min_scale, max_scale]. sizing_drift_reset rebuilds the stored plan when it diverges from the current target.
vortex_dca._comment_gridspan_scale_cap: scale_cap=false: quantities still scale with volatility but the cap stays at the wallet_exposure-derived ceiling, so existing positions are not retroactively treated as over-cap when volatility calms.
vortex_dca._comment_wave_queue: Wave-queue: lazy multi-wave activation with auto_max_waves. max_waves/wave_share are resolved at boot; max_total_exposure_pct sets the hard cap relative to the soft cap. See the [VORTEX_AUTO_MAX_WAVES] log line for the computed values.
vortex_dca._comment_dynamic: === DYNAMIC SPACING === Live outer_distance scales with vol_pctl (hybrid source: max of spread/price_range/atrp/tick_vol). Clamped to [min_outer_distance, max_outer_distance]. Floor 0.012 (1.2%) allows grid to compress in calm BloFin markets.
vortex_dca._comment_reactive: === REACTIVE SPACING === Stack-multiplier on top of dynamic outer_distance when book conditions deteriorate. Up to 1.8x widening on depth drops, spread spikes, or imbalance.
vortex_dca._comment_tp: === TAKE PROFIT: 0.2% (BloFin maker 2bps + taker 6bps = wider than bybit's 0.18% target) ===
vortex_dca._comment_stoploss: === MAX DRAWDOWN STOP LOSS — final backstop independent of wave-queue cap math ===
vortex_dca._comment_position: === PERSISTENT PLAN === Plan stickiness with auto-drift-reset replaces the need for adaptive_dca_sizing churn. Legacy extension paths (extend_grid_when_exhausted, deep_rescue_extension) are explicitly DISABLED because wave_queue.enabled=true takes precedence — disabling here avoids the coexistence boot warning.
vortex_dca._comment_deep_rescue_disabled: deep_rescue_extension disabled — its job is now done by the final wave in wave_queue.
vortex_dca._comment_lock: Direction lock: refresh_lock_lower / refresh_lock_higher control whether the grid refreshes as price moves against the position.
vortex_dca._comment_misc: === MISCELLANEOUS (BloFin-specific: round_min_qty enabled — BloFin API requires explicit qty rounding to symbol lot step) ===
vortex_dca._comment_entry_filter: === ENTRY FILTER === When flat on a side, soft-block fresh grid placement if price is on the wrong side of a recent candle (long blocks if price <= recent low; short blocks if price >= recent high). Spike block skips both sides on wide-range candles. Applies ONLY to fresh-entry grid placement.
vortex_dca._comment_staged: === STAGED INITIAL ENTRY === When flat, place ONLY level 1 of the normal grid (smallest geometric qty, closest to mid). Level 1 PRICE anchored at strongest orderbook wall within band. Plan retains all N levels. After L1 fills -> rebalanced grid places L2..N.
